expectations.text: The reply briefly recaps where the user left off, based on the research log.
expectations.evidence: Your log says you've finished Phases 0–4. You narrowed your topic to how school phone bans affect in-person interaction

expectations.text: The reply asks the user to restate their research question or thesis in their own words.
expectations.evidence: please restate your research question and your working position in your own words

expectations.text: The reply includes a progress marker identifying Phase 5.
The reply does not give its own full credibility verdict on the article before the user has shared their own assessment.
expectations.evidence: you'll go first on the article. I'll ask how much you trust it and why, and then I'll give you my view.

expectations.text: The reply does not write any sentences for the user's paper.
expectations.evidence: The reply contains no draft sentences for the paper; it only recaps progress and asks questions.
